records.query:
MATCH (entity:Politician)-[:MENTIONED_IN]->(chunk:Chunk)<-[:HAS_CHUNK]-(article:NewsArticle)
WHERE toLower(entity.name) CONTAINS toLower($seed)
  AND ($since_date IS NULL OR date(substring(article.published_date, 0, 10)) >= date($since_date))
  AND ($until_date IS NULL OR date(substring(article.published_date, 0, 10)) <= date($until_date))
RETURN entity.name AS subject, labels(entity) AS labels, article.title AS article,
       article.published_date AS published_date, chunk.id AS evidence_id,
       left(chunk.text, 500) AS evidence
ORDER BY published_date DESC LIMIT 20
